messages.subject: [Traminer-users] OMstran
messages.body_plain:
Dear TraMineR users,

My question is simple. I am very happy to find new measures of distance in TraMineR, but I cannot figure out how to use Optimal Matching between sequences of transitions (OMstran). The parameters "transindel", "otto" return an error message whatever the argument I use. Do you have an example of syntax using OMstran?

Best regard,

Alexandre Pollien

FORS - International surveys
University of Lausanne
Geopolis
CH-1015 Lausanne
Switzerland
